wa_faq_title: How WhatsApp Multi-Device Works & Safety Guidelines
wa_faq_1_q: Does my phone need to stay online?
wa_faq_1_a: With WhatsApp Multi-Device protocol, your phone does not need to remain continuously connected to the Internet once paired. However, WhatsApp requires you to open the app on your primary phone at least once every 14 days to keep linked devices active.
wa_faq_2_q: Can multiple managers reply at the same time?
wa_faq_2_a: Yes! All assigned operators in QoraCRM can communicate with clients simultaneously from the single WhatsApp number.
wa_faq_3_q: Is it safe from account bans?
wa_faq_3_a: QoraCRM uses official Multi-Device linked device handshakes for regular customer support. To keep your number safe, do not use it for mass cold spamming.
